# Børne- og ungdomspsyk. Ambulatorium

Børne- og ungdomspsyk. Ambulatorium is a child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic ("ambulatorium") operating under Region Nordjylland [^src1] [^src2] [^src3] [^src5] [^src8]. It appears repeatedly throughout the Danish ADHD-databasen's annual quality reports for the periods 01.04.2023–31.03.2024 and 01.04.2024–31.03.2025, where it is listed alongside other regional child and adolescent psychiatric units as one of the reporting facilities whose treatment courses are tracked against national quality indicators for ADHD diagnosis and care [^src4] [^src6] [^src10].

The clinic's performance varies considerably depending on the indicator measured. On somatic examination within 120 days of the start of assessment (part of the broader indicator set covering diagnostic and treatment processes), the ambulatorium reported 265 out of 412 treatment courses completed, a 64% fulfillment rate [^src1]. On Indicator 3 — which the report clarifies elsewhere concerns diagnostic conferences held within 120 days of assessment start — the clinic achieved a 34% fulfillment rate among the same 412 assessment courses (95% CI: 30-39) [^src3]. This is notably below the database's universal standard of 90% [^src3].

Elsewhere the clinic reported much lower fulfillment: on a separate indicator (recorded as "Nej 7 / 23 0 (0) 30 (13-53)") the ambulatorium showed 0% (0 of 23 relevant cases) [^src2]. On Indicator 4, concerning coordinating network meetings within 90 days of treatment start, the clinic achieved just 16% fulfillment (84 of 525 courses, 95% CI: 13-19) [^src5], and on a related measure it recorded 0% fulfillment with 167 of 525 courses (95% CI: 28-36 for a companion figure of 32%) [^src7]. These low figures are consistent with the broader national picture described in the source reports: Indicator 4 has stood far below the 90% development goal since its introduction, with a national average fulfillment of only 20%, attributed to pressure on both specialized psychiatry and primary care, geographic challenges, and competing priorities [^src5] [^src7].

By contrast, on at least one measure the ambulatorium performed strongly relative to peers. A statistical comparison across departments with more than 10 treatment courses found fulfillment ranging "from 18% (BUA Psykiatrisk klinik for småbørn, Midtjylland) to 87% ([[boerne-ungdomspsyk-ambulatorium-nordjylland|Børne- og ungdomspsyk. Ambulatorium]], Nordjylland)" [^src8] — placing the Nordjylland clinic at the top end of departmental performance on that particular indicator, in contrast to its notably weaker showing on Indicator 4 and the somatic/diagnostic-conference measures. The clinic also appears in tables covering Indicator 3 (page 46) [^src9] and in the appendices of the 2024 report listing PS Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorier data on Indicator 4-related figures (99 of 555 courses, 18% CI 15-21) [^src4] and a further figure of 183 of 555 courses (33%, CI 29-37) [^src6], as well as in the styregruppe/appendix section of the 2024 report [^src10].

Taken together, the entity fits into the broader story told by the ADHD-databasen reports: a national quality-monitoring system tracking ADHD assessment and treatment across Denmark's five regions, where most indicators fall well short of the 90% standard, reflecting strained child and adolescent psychiatric services, staffing shortages, and rising referral numbers [^src1] [^src3] [^src5] [^src8]. The clinic is explicitly tied to [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] across multiple report sections [^src1] [^src2] [^src3] [^src5] [^src8], and is compared directly against other departments such as [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern|BUA Psykiatrisk klinik for småbørn]] in Midtjylland [^src8].

## Claims

**Performance**
- Børne- og ungdomspsyk. Ambulatorium i Region Nordjylland opnåede 34 % opfyldelse af Indikator 3 blandt 412 udredningsforløb [^src3] (boerne-ungdomspsyk-ambulatorium-nordjylland, indikator-3)

**Facility-performance**
- Børne- og ungdomspsyk. Ambulatorium i Region Nordjylland havde 16 % opfyldelse af indikator 4 (95% CI: 13-19) med 84 forløb ud af 525 [^src1] (boerne-ungdomspsyk-ambulatorium-nordjylland)

**Statistical**
- På afdelingsniveau (afdelinger med over 10 forløb) fra 18 % (BUA Psykiatrisk klinik for småbørn, Midtjylland) til 87 % (Børne- og ungdomspsyk. Ambulatorium, Nordjylland) [^src1] (bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-smaaboern, boerne-ungdomspsyk-ambulatorium-nordjylland)
